Initially, OneShot didn't really hook me. After first playing, I found it as a game with confusing and often tiresome puzzles, an unclear story, and not much emotional attachment, and I stopped playing after finishing the Glen. Replaying, I can say that after the initial ending, I found it underwhelming - surprisingly short, without much content, but enjoyable, with fun enough characters, an interesting world, with nice art and music, and a notable story, even if without solstice it is confusing. Now, the actual Solstice route is much better, with a much more intruiging story and a likable list of characters (even if the time spent with them is short), and so much explanation to the nature of this game's world, and finally a great ending to this game. This is what pushed it from a 7 to squarely an 8/10. Recommend it, I suggest one uses a walkthrough or guide if necessary!
